description: A Kenyan geoportal of crop pest, disease and weed data. The hub page says the Plant Protection and Food Safety Directorate geoportal is a decision support platform holding data for managing crop pests, diseases and invasive weeds, used for spatial analysis of infestation trends and early action, and that users can view the data and download it for offline use. It groups thematic data for rodents, diseases, insects, birds, slugs and snails and nematodes, has county pages for Kakamega, Kilifi and Nyeri, and links the SERVIR Rangelands Decision Support Tool and a global land cover explorer. It is free to use online, hosted on ArcGIS Hub by RCMRD. Coverage is Kenya. Caveats: the licence, update frequency and time span of layers are not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives pest outbreak layers that combine with drought and heat to explain crop losses and to target early response. A related catalogue record is the GEOGLAM Crop Monitor.
